content: Prisma + Supabase PgBouncer gotchas: (1) Never run prisma migrate dev against the pooler URL (port 6543) — it hangs on advisory locks. Always use DIRECT_URL for migrations. (2) Add ?pgbouncer=true to the pooler DATABASE_URL to disable prepared statements. (3) On Vercel serverless, also add ?connection_limit=1 to avoid saturating connections. (4) Session pooler (port 5432, mode=session) works fine with Prisma but doesn't scale as well — use it only for migrations via DIRECT_URL. (5) Free tier has 60 direct connections, 200 pooler connections. (6) Free projects pause after 7 days of inactivity — add a daily Vercel cron job that pings the DB.
